text: This is what the number chart looks like for You Are My Sun Shine. I'm going to play the song in three different keys. First we'll begin with the key of G. This means every time I see a 1, I'll play the G chord. When I see a 1 7, I'll play the G 7th chord. When I see a 4, I'll play the C chord, and when I see a 5, I'll play the D chord. You are my sun shining, my only sunshine. You make me happy when skies are gray. You'll never know, dear, how much I love you. Please don't take my sun shine away. Now I'm going to play the song in the key of C. This means when I see a 1, I'll play a C. When I see a 1 7, I'll play a C 7th. When I see a 4, I'll play an F, and when I see a 5, I'll play the G. You are my sun shining, my only sunshine. You make me happy when skies are gray. You'll never know, dear, how much I love you. Please don't take my sun shine away. Now I'll play the song in the key of A. This means when I see the 1, I will play an A chord. When I see a 4, I'll play the D, and when I see a 5, I'll play the E chord. You are my sun shining, my only sunshine. You make me happy when skies are gray. You'll never know, dear, how much I love you. Please don't take my sun shine away. This is a guitar chord chart of all of the chords I know on the guitar. For years, I sat on a stool and played guitar with these chords at Lee's in Shreveport, Louisiana. It was a kind of cheers place and had so much fun. I was able to play hundreds of songs in several different keys with just these chords. I started with A, D, and E when I was a Girl Scout because I wanted to play the guitar when my friends and I would sit around a campfire and sing Girl Scout songs. By knowing the chords A, D, and E, I found that I could play all kinds of songs that I liked. While I was watching television, I would practice by moving my fingers around on the guitar neck. When I was able to make the transition between the chords easily, I started singing. If you already play the guitar and you want to learn how to build chords on the piano, that lesson is coming up. My brother plays guitar and one day he said, "I should like to play the piano." I sat down with him at the piano, showed him how to build chords and you should hear him play the piano now.
